# EmailFlow

> EmailFlow is an Omnisend email marketing agency serving UK and UAE ecommerce stores remotely. We work exclusively with Omnisend. Core services cover lifecycle flows, campaigns, segmentation and deliverability support.

## Services
- [Email marketing for UAE ecommerce brands](https://www.emailflow.uk/uae/)
- [Ecommerce email management](https://www.emailflow.uk/ecommerce-email-marketing-agency/)
- [Omnisend agency support](https://www.emailflow.uk/omnisend-agency/)
- [Shopify email marketing](https://www.emailflow.uk/shopify-email-marketing-agency/)
- [Email automation](https://www.emailflow.uk/email-automation/)

## Scope and measurement
Management is £800/month excluding VAT, including the Omnisend subscription, with no setup fee, four monthly campaigns and a three-month minimum term; the proposal confirms deliverables, initial flow quantities and any additional work. Core implementation may follow a seven-day plan after access, content and approvals are ready. Revenue growth, list growth and inbox placement are not guaranteed. Platform-attributed revenue does not establish incremental store growth. Case studies describe individual accounts and should be read with their measurement limitations.

Minimum term: three months. Give one month’s notice to end management after the minimum term. On exit, agency-created flows, templates, forms and designs are removed. The client keeps their account, subscriber data and reports.

Consultations are free 20-minute calls. The managed service is available to stores with monthly revenue of £10,000 or more; suitability also depends on traffic, permissions, buying cycle, margins and existing performance.

This optional summary accompanies the public HTML pages. It does not guarantee inclusion in search or AI answers.

## Store starting points
We support UK ecommerce stores starting email marketing and stores improving an existing Omnisend programme. The homepage calculator uses an illustrative 10% share of store sales, not an Omnisend benchmark or a forecast.

## UAE pricing
The UAE page displays an indicative AED 3,930/month equivalent of the existing fee at 1 GBP ≈ AED 4.91 on 9 November 2026. The proposal confirms the final AED fee and billing terms. UAE consultation revenue bands use the same indicative conversion. Arabic copy and right-to-left templates require an agreed scope.
